expression_restriction.value: Neutral facial expression with closed lips, eyes open and clearly visible, direct camera gaze

glasses_policy.value: No colored lenses or sunglasses; clear prescription glasses allowed with no reflections on frames; frame edges must not obstruct eyes

face_visibility.value: Face must be centered and fully visible including hairstyle; hair must not cover eyes; chin to forehead must be visible

headwear_policy.value: Hats, headbands, and similar items prohibited; hijab/religious head covering acceptable but must not create shadows on face; chin to forehead must remain visible

accessories.value: No glasses, earrings, hats, or clothing/accessories that prevent face from being seen

size.evidence: The official Turkish NVI (Nufus ve Vatandaslik Isleri Genel Mudurlugu) page was fetched directly and states in Turkish: 'Ebati 50 mm X 60 mm, beyaz fonda ve desensiz olmalidir' (The size must be 50mm x 60mm, with a white and patternless background). It also explicitly warns photographers NOT to cut biometric photos to 35x45mm. This matches the claimed value. The Turkish MFA Los Angeles consulate page (losangeles-cg.mfa.gov.tr) independently confirms 50mm x 60mm as well.
